review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 89 retail bytes, 36 instructions, 13 blocks, 17 edges; the candidate measures 16 blocks / 24 edges at CFG 1.000, the same shape the other dynobj bodies show when GCC folds the ASCII range comparisons.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: One cdecl argument read from [esp+4]; the routine loads the character pointer from object+0x14 and never writes through the argument.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Character constants transcribed as the exact bytes retail compares against: 0x30-0x39, 0x24, 0x61-0x66, 0x41-0x46, 0x78, 0x58. No case folding, locale or sign-extension was added.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Two byte reads at text[0] and text[1] through the +0x14 pointer. No store, no bounds check, no indirect access; the +0x14 offset is all this body establishes about the object.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No call and no store: the only effect is the 0/1 return value, so there is no side effect to compare.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Six exits enumerated: digit, $digit, $a-f, $A-F, 0x, X, and the final 0. The fall-through order is retail's, including the second-byte 'X' test running after the '0' test fails or its 'x' test misses.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Character comparisons only; no floating-point register is touched.

runtime_contract.scope: paired retail/candidate observation of the classifier entry and its 0/1 return during level-1 startup

limitations: Retail observed 256 entries and 256 returns (the observation cap) so the routine is on the level-1 startup path and runs often; the return values recorded are not yet compared against the candidate, because the candidate exits at 0x00402930 before any game native runs.
The object type is not established beyond the +0x14 character pointer.
